title: Four private Michigan islands spanning 520 acres hit the market for $2.3 million
summary_full: Now on the market for $2.3 million, this exclusive private group of four islands spans 520 acres. It features a beautifully renovated home, essential machinery, two boats, and a dock slip on the mainland. With about 2,000 feet of waterfront along Michigan's northern border, most of the property is safeguarded by a conservation easement, preserving the area’s native ecosystems and ensuring enjoyment for generations to come.
